nodes.label: Deduplicate Global Event Listeners
nodes.rationale: A hook that adds its own window listener registers N listeners for N call sites; a module-level Map of key -> Set<callback> plus a single useSWRSubscription('global-keydown') collapses that to one listener that fans out to the registered callbacks.

edges.source_location: both collapse N-per-instance work to one by keying on a string through SWR - '/api/users' for requests, 'global-keydown' for listeners
both show the same anti-pattern (a hook that add/removeEventListener with the handler in its dep array) and fix listener churn differently: a module-level callback registry vs a per-hook ref
